data_export_subject: Your SACDIA data export is ready
account_deletion_subject: Your SACDIA account has been deleted

email_verification.preview: Verify your email address to activate your SACDIA account.
email_verification.title: Verify your email address
email_verification.body: {greeting}. To activate your SACDIA account, click the button below. This link is valid for 24 hours.
email_verification.footer: If you did not create a SACDIA account, you can safely ignore this email. No changes will be made to your account.

password_reset.preview: You received a request to reset your SACDIA password.
password_reset.title: Reset your password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your SACDIA account. Click the button below to choose a new password. This link is valid for 1 hour.
password_reset.footer: If you did not request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your current password will not change. If you suspect unauthorized activity, contact support at hola@sacdia.app.

account_deletion.preview: Your SACDIA account has been successfully deleted.
account_deletion.title: Your account has been deleted
account_deletion.body: Your SACDIA account deletion request was processed successfully. Your personal data has been anonymized in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
account_deletion.data_summary:
— Your profile was anonymized (name, email, photo removed)
— All your active sessions were revoked
— Your password was permanently deleted
— Your device tokens were deactivated
account_deletion.footer: Anonymous historical records (honors, class progress, activities) may be retained for a retention period in accordance with our data policy. For more information, contact us at hola@sacdia.app.

data_export.preview: Your SACDIA data export is ready to download.
data_export.title: Your data export is ready
data_export.body: We have generated your personal data export in accordance with GDPR. You can download it directly from the SACDIA app.
data_export.button: View my data in the app
data_export.expires_note: This link expires on {expiresAt} UTC. After that date, you will need to request a new export from Settings → Privacy → Export my data.
data_export.fallback_note: If the button doesn't work, open the SACDIA app and navigate to Settings → Privacy → My exports.

layout.footer_auto: This email was sent automatically by SACDIA. If you did not take any action, you can safely ignore it.
